store.description: The store printed in the receipt header

retailer.description: Retailer name from the logo, e.g. 'Costco Wholesale'

store_name_number.description: Store name and number as printed under the logo, e.g. 'Greenville #1005'

address.description: Store street address, city, state and ZIP, as printed

transaction_datetime.description: Date and time of the purchase as printed near the foot of the receipt, e.g. '03/31/2019 10:31'

items.description: Every item purchased, one entry per item line, in the order printed

item_number.description: The retailer's item or SKU number printed before the description

name.description: Item description exactly as printed, e.g. 'GRAPE TOMATO'

quantity.description: Quantity purchased. Use the printed quantity if there is one; otherwise 1

unit_price.description: Price of one unit. If no unit price is printed and quantity is 1, the line total

total_price.description: Line total printed in the price column

tax_flag.description: The tax code letter printed beside the item, e.g. 'E'

taxable.description: Whether the item was taxed. On this receipt 'E' marks an item exempt from tax; null if the receipt does not say

card_type.description: Card brand or name as printed, e.g. 'Costco Visa'

card_last_four.description: The last four digits of the masked card number

entry_method.description: How the card was read, e.g. 'CHIP Read'

approval_status.description: Response printed for the authorization, e.g. 'APPROVED'
